text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Well, the Derby is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: While I'm running, I might not be able to hold back anymore, you know?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Her legs might end up in bad shape too.
choice_data_list: If that happens, I'll spend the rest of my life making it up to you.
If that happens, I'll spend the rest of my life making it up to you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Why go that far?
choice_data_list: Because there's something I want you to see.
Because there's something I want you to see.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume in the eye of the storm
doesn't seem to understand Brian yet, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Her running is incredible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Looking away will surely get us nowhere.

text_block_list.text: ...From the yearning held in that heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Choooo-eyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've come to cheer you on!
Laurel-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Baku-chan, Chiyo-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I heard from Trainer that you'd be running today!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um...! If you're going after
a dream that means the world to you,
we'll back you up with all our hearts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't do anything to stop you.
Which is why—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Take this.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It's a good luck charm.
From everyone at the Victory Club.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Please be sure to come back, Laurel-san.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaaale...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (...I'm sorry.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I was being selfish.
I really should have withdrawn on my own,
...yet I agreed to run anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (......I want to become a Derby Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (......I want to beat that girl I saw at the Satsuki Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (I want to win... in the Derby...!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Make a choice you won't regret.
Make a choice that you won't regret.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes...!
